author: AndrewJKim
body:
Username: Ambamore2000
Reason: Excessive Infractions - jozzmcozz
Why I am Appealing:
I am appealing because I feel I am ready, and have grown out of my immaturity to the point where I am still immature, but at times I will act knowingly. Previously, I have sent an appeal about a month ago and received a decline notification, due to the lack of effort put into it. Now, I want to explain a thorough and detailed reason of why I am sending this appeal request. It's been a few months since I have been banned, apparently 7 months according to a staff member here. I've avoided Avicus due to the hatred brought upon me. Now, of course, I brought my own hatred on myself, so to deal with that, I've simply attempted to ban myself where it wasn't as serious of an infraction as hacking. Although I think I am ready to come back to a network where I have been previously banned, there may be some reasons, which I regret, that I won't get appealed. This is to give you guys an idea of who I really was back when I enjoyed avicus, and I wish I have realized it when I was younger so I could've been mature and stop myself. I've attempted to frame a staff member, whose name will be classified, in a report. I also want to point out that I've made many comparisons of how Avicus was just a sham of the Overcast Network. There was a staff member whom I've hated alot and it wasn't smart of me to gossip about them. Last issue I want to explain; my infractions show that I was very rude and disobedient to players. These are a few things I regret, and will never do if I were to be appealed. This summarizes my appeal request. I do hope I get appealed, but I shouldn't complain if it were to be declined, nor have pride when passed.

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Hello Ambamore,

I have decided to lift your punishment because you have spent a significant amount of time as a banned user, and wrote a thorough and honest appeal. However, if you are banned again, you will not receive another chance to become unbanned.

Regards,

Peacheh, Avicus Network Administrator.
